title: Indestructible Fix for Modular Bees
description: This mod uses a Mixin to replace GameUtil.fastDamage with the vanilla ItemStack.hurtAndBreak, enabling the Indestructible enchantment to work on Modular Bees items that consume durability.
body:
本模组通过 Mixin 将模块化蜜蜂 (Modular Bees)的 GameUtil.fastDamage 替换为原版 ItemStack.hurtAndBreak，使附魔：无法破坏 (Indestructible Enchantment)的效果能够支持该模组的物品。

This mod uses a Mixin to replace GameUtil.fastDamage with the vanilla ItemStack.hurtAndBreak, enabling the Indestructible enchantment to work on Modular Bees items that consume durability.
